'''Sateen Vestswe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. He was [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] loyal bodyguard. The [[Vestswe family]] had served the [[House of Organa/Legends|royal family]] for over forty generations. Sateen was trained by [[Giles Durane]], the "Weapons Master".

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] named Sateen Vestswe was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. For over forty generations before him, [[Vestswe family|his family]] had dutifully served the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal House]] of Alderaan, and he was no exception to that tradition.<ref name="CSWE" /> He became both a [[senatorial aide]]<ref name="Arch" /> and a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Prince Consort]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]],<ref name="CSWE" /> who represented the [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic.<ref name="dbOrg">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref> In order to become a crack shot with a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], Vestswe trained under [[Giles Durane]], a good-hearted idealist who was known as the "Weapons Master."<ref name="CSWE" /> Vestswe followed Senator Organa on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> a three-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] conflict that raged on from [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], under the rule of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

At the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars, Palpatine let his true [[Color/Legends|colors]] show. He [[Declaration of a New Order|established]] a new, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|autocratic regime]] and decreed that all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] should be [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|massacred]]. Being a Jedi sympathizer, Bail Organa decided to help two survivors, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], reach their ruined [[Jedi Temple/Legends|headquarters]] and recalibrate the [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing signal]] telling all Jedi to return home because the war was over. Vestswe and the rest of Organa's aides accompanied the senator and his Jedi friends. After landing on Coruscant, the group encountered a [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] who tried to take custody of the Jedi, which Master Kenobi prevented by using a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the weak-minded guard.<ref name="ROTSN" />

==Personality and traits==
Vestswe was a fair-skinned man with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. By 19 BBY, he sported a full beard.<ref name="DAG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sateen Vestswe was to appear in the [[2005]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], in which he was played by [[Scott Mewett]]. While Mewett's only scene was left on the cutting room's floor,<ref name="Arch" /> it did appear in the movie's [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]]. Although Vestswe's name was not referred to by name, the narrative mentioned "the Senator [Bail Organa] and his aides."<ref name="ROTSN" />

The character of [[Zinn Paulness/Legends|Zinn Paulness]], who appeared in "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," a [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']], was based on Vestswe's design.<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref>
